HomePage.heroDescription: I build software by combining engineering, product thinking and modern development tools. Most projects here start with a problem I'd like to solve myself.
HomePage.striveDescription: Strive is a habit tracker I originally built for myself. It has since become my main playground for experimenting with product ideas, full-stack engineering and AI-assisted workflows.
HomePage.professionalWorkDescription: I build internal software used by customer service, sales and production teams.
